Purpose-built software for planning and building products

Track engineering issues, sprint cycles, and multi-quarter product roadmaps with keyboard-first navigation and sub-50ms local IndexedDB synchronization. Every transition, filter, and triage shortcut executes against an optimistic local store before syncing delta packets over WebSockets so teams never wait on spinners during standup or incident response.

Start building Read documentation

Cycles, triage queues, and Git automation

Link pull requests from GitHub or GitLab to move issues automatically from in-progress to merged when branch checks pass. Triage queues isolate incoming bug reports, customer escalations, and telemetry alerts from active cycle commitments so engineers keep uninterrupted focus while product leads review scope trade-offs with real velocity charts.

Command menus bind every action to a two-key chord: assign owners, attach milestone dates, filter by label, or copy branch names without lifting your hands from the keyboard. Workspace data exports cleanly to Postgres or BigQuery on an hourly schedule for custom reporting.
